title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Step "worked", insulin.dynamicCaption(), type="long" branch; not pictured
findings.title: Worked caption generalizes glargine U-100 timing to all long-acting insulin
findings.problem: For {type:"long", givenAt:"21:00"}, the caption says "Long-acting insulin ... a steady effect that wanes at about a day." Only glargine U-100 is modeled. This drops the product distinction maintained elsewhere and teaches a class-wide duration that does not apply to glargine U-300 or degludec.
findings.fix: Name "Glargine U-100" explicitly in this caption, using WORKED_LABEL[type] or ins.eg. Add a caption assertion for the existing long-insulin test case.

findings.where: All images, horizontal axis; especially images 8 and 16, step "worked"
findings.title: Elapsed hours are not distinguished from clock times
findings.problem: The worked example labels the peak "11:00–19:00" above a band spanning 4h–12h, but the axis never says these are hours since injection. The conversion is correct; the missing axis label leaves two time systems unexplained in the same picture.
findings.fix: Label the horizontal axis "Hours after injection" and identify 0h as the injection time. Retain the clock-time peak annotation.

assessment: Revise the basal-insulin worked caption and clarify the time axis. Peak-window arithmetic, including midnight rollover, is correct.
